notes: Added URL validation integration story to close gap between link construction and safe delivery.

change_log.value: New story for URL validation integration using url_guardian
change_log.note: Close safety and reliability gap for external links

stories.title: Define External Link Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a structured schema for external verification links including site name (Healthgrades, NPI Registry, State Board), URL, label, and guidance text for user interpretation.

stories.title: Implement External Link Construction Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to construct external verification links using provider identifiers (e.g., NPI, state) including Healthgrades, NPI Registry, and state medical board URLs.

stories.title: Expose External Links via EvaluateCare Facade and UI Rendering
stories.description: Expose structured external links through the EvaluateCare facade and render them in the frontend with clear labels and guidance text to help users understand what each source represents.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for External Links
stories.description: Create unit tests for link construction logic and integration tests to validate end-to-end delivery of external links in provider detail responses, including handling missing data (e.g., missing state board link).

stories.title: Integrate URL Validation for External Links
stories.description: Integrate url_guardian to validate and sanitize all external verification links (HEAD check, AI verification, fallback correction) before returning them to the frontend to ensure links are safe, reachable, and trustworthy.
